timezone.zh: 中欧时间（法兰克福，CET，UTC+1；夏令时CEST，UTC+2）
timezone.en: Central European Time (Frankfurt, CET, UTC+1; CEST UTC+2 during daylight saving)

dst_rule.zh: 实行夏令时（随欧盟统一切换CET/CEST），与同集团de-eurex一致
dst_rule.en: Observes daylight saving time (switches CET/CEST in line with the EU), same as de-eurex

founded_year.zh: 1585（法兰克福商人为统一汇兑牌价而集会，官方史料将此事件视为法兰克福交易所的诞生时刻）；现行电子交易系统Xetra于1997年上线
founded_year.en: 1585 (merchants met to establish uniform exchange rates; officially regarded as the moment of the Frankfurt exchange's birth); the current electronic trading system Xetra was launched in 1997

sources.title: The Frankfurt Stock Exchange — History（Deutsche Börse官网）

founded_year.quote: merchants at the fair met in 1585 in order to establish uniform exchange rates. Today, this event is regarded as the moment of the Frankfurt exchange's birth. ... With the launch of Xetra in 1997, the Frankfurt Stock Exchange succeeded not only in strengthening its own competitive position.

history.zh: 1585年商人集会统一汇兑牌价视为交易所诞生；1808年并入法兰克福商会成为公法性质机构；1990年交易所的行政运营从商会移交新设立的法兰克福证券交易所股份公司（后更名为Deutsche Börse AG）；1997年电子交易系统Xetra上线，成为主流交易场所，原有场内交易（专家做市）保留为「Börse Frankfurt」
history.en: 1585: merchants' meeting to unify exchange rates, regarded as the exchange's birth; 1808: brought under the Frankfurt Chamber of Commerce as a public-sector institution; 1990: administration transferred from the Chamber of Commerce to the newly founded Frankfurter Wertpapierbörse AG (renamed Deutsche Börse AG shortly after); 1997: the electronic trading system Xetra launched and became the dominant venue, with floor-based specialist trading continuing as "Börse Frankfurt"

sources.title: The Frankfurt Stock Exchange — History（Deutsche Börse官网）

history.quote: In 1990, administration and operation of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange were transferred from the Frankfurt Chamber of Commerce and Industry to the newly founded Frankfurter Wertpapierbörse AG, which became Deutsche Börse AG shortly afterwards.

organization_form.zh: 公法机构（具有有限法律行为能力的公法机构，本身不能作为私法主体），由Deutsche Börse AG作为运营公司（Trägerin）负责人员/资金/场地等运营事项——不属于enums.yml现有四个组织形式词条（公司制上市/公司制未上市/会员制/国有事业单位制）中的任何一个，是本项目首次遇到的第五种模式，见文件顶部说明与OPEN-QUESTIONS
organization_form.en: Public-law institution with limited legal capacity (cannot itself be a private-law legal entity); Deutsche Börse AG acts as the operating company ("Trägerin") providing staff, funds and premises — does not cleanly fit any of the four existing organization_form enum values (demutualized listed/unlisted, member-owned, state-owned); this is the project's first encounter with this fifth pattern, see file header and OPEN-QUESTIONS
organization_form.detail:
与 de-eurex（Eurex Deutschland，私法主体的公司）的关键区别：FWB 官方原文明确排除了
"私法主体"这个可能性（"cannot act as a legal entity under private law"），因此不能像
Eurex那样归入"公司制未上市"——它根本不是公司。也不宜归为"国有事业单位制"，因为运营
公司Deutsche Börse AG是一家跨国上市公司而非德国政府直接持有运营的国企；也不是"会员制"
（未见FWB本身有会员出资/表决结构，1808年后即为公法机构而非会员合伙）。故意不套用现有
enum，如实留空。

sources.title: Organisation of the FWB（Deutsche Börse官网，法律结构说明页）

organization_form.quote: In Germany, a stock exchange, as a public law institution with limited legal capacity, cannot act as a legal entity under private law. An organiser is required for the execution and appropriate development of stock exchange operations. ... The organising company of the Frankfurter Wertpapierbörse (FWB®, Frankfurt Stock Exchange) is Deutsche Börse AG.

self_listed.zh: 否——FWB本身是公法机构，依官方原文的表述根本不能作为私法主体存在，因而不存在「FWB自身股份」这个概念；其运营公司Deutsche Börse AG是一家独立上市公司，但那是另一层法律实体，与de-eurex的情况相同
self_listed.en: No — FWB itself is a public-law institution and, per the official text, cannot exist as a private-law entity, so there is no concept of "FWB's own shares"; its operating company Deutsche Börse AG is a separately listed company, a distinct legal layer, same structure as de-eurex
self_listed.detail: 比de-eurex的同类字段更确定：Eurex Deutschland「未上市」是消极事实（未找到反证，故confidence medium）；FWB「不能自身上市」则是官方原文正面排除私法主体资格的直接逻辑推论，故本字段标high。

sources.title: Organisation of the FWB（Deutsche Börse官网）

self_listed.quote: In Germany, a stock exchange, as a public law institution with limited legal capacity, cannot act as a legal entity under private law.

trading_currency.zh: 以欧元为主；管理董事会可为个别证券另行指定交易货币与结算货币，允许多币种交易/结算
trading_currency.en: Primarily EUR; the Management Board may designate a different trading and settlement currency for individual Securities, allowing multi-currency trading/settlement

sources.title: Exchange Rules for the FWB（「Börsenordnung」，§58）PDF

trading_currency.quote: The Management Board shall determine the trading currency and the currency of settlement for the Securities to be introduced. It may decide that a Security shall be traded or settled in several currencies.

settlement_currency.zh: 原则上同交易货币（以欧元为主），个别证券可另设结算货币，规则依据同trading_currency
settlement_currency.en: In principle the same as the trading currency (primarily EUR); individual Securities may have a different settlement currency, same rule basis as trading_currency

regulator.zh: 黑森州最高联邦州级主管机关（交易所监管机关，Exchange Supervisory Authority）——与de-eurex记录的机关同一层级，不是联邦金融监管局BaFin；但BaFin在证券发行披露/持续披露/卖空监管等业务行为层面另有联邦级监管职能，见disclosure_requirements与continuing_obligations字段
regulator.en: Highest competent federal state authority of the State of Hesse ("Exchange Supervisory Authority") — same level as recorded for de-eurex, not the federal BaFin; BaFin separately holds federal-level supervisory functions over disclosure/short-selling matters, see disclosure_requirements and continuing_obligations fields

sources.title: Exchange Rules for the FWB（Annex I定义表）

regulator.quote: Exchange Supervisory Authority     Highest competent federal state authority of the State of Hesse

self_regulatory_org.zh: 交易所理事会（Exchange Council / Börsenrat）：负责发布交易所规则、交易条件、费用规则、交易员准入规则，并在与交易所监管机关协商后任免管理董事会成员
self_regulatory_org.en: Exchange Council (Börsenrat): responsible for issuing the Exchange Rules, Conditions for Transactions, Fee Regulations and admission rules for Exchange Traders, and appoints/dismisses Managing Directors in agreement with the Exchange Supervisory Authority
self_regulatory_org.quote: The Exchange Council has the following responsibilities: 1. issuance of the Exchange Rules; 2. issuance of Conditions for Transactions on the exchange; 3. issuance of the Fee Regulations; 4. issuance of admission and registration rules for Exchange Traders

foreign_ownership_limit.zh: 德国对上市证券（股票）不设一般性外资持股比例限制；FWB《交易所规则》未规定股东国籍/外资比例上限。德国对外国直接投资（FDI）的安全审查（依据《对外贸易与支付法》AWG）仅针对国防、关键基础设施等特定行业，不约束普通上市公司的外资持股
foreign_ownership_limit.en: Germany imposes no general foreign-ownership limit on listed securities (equities); the FWB Exchange Rules set no cap on shareholder nationality / foreign shareholding. Germany's foreign direct investment (FDI) screening under the Foreign Trade and Payments Act (AWG) applies only to specific sectors such as defence and critical infrastructure, not to ordinary listed-company shareholding
foreign_ownership_limit.detail: 与 capital_controls 同理，外资持股限制主要在国家投资审查法层面；普通股票市场的外资准入是自由的，本次未在FWB规则中找到任何外资持股上限条款

sources.title: Exchange Rules for the FWB PDF

capital_controls.zh: 德国（欧元区）不设资本管制；法兰克福证券交易所（FWB）的《交易所规则》中并无资本管制类条款，与德国作为欧盟成员国、适用《欧盟运作条约》资本自由流动原则（TFEU 第63条）的框架一致
capital_controls.en: Germany (Eurozone) imposes no capital controls; the FWB Exchange Rules contain no capital-control provision, consistent with Germany's status as an EU member state applying the free movement of capital under TFEU Article 63
capital_controls.detail: 资本管制属国家/欧盟层面事项，非交易所规则所规定；本次抓取材料未找到FWB规则中有任何资本流动限制条款，故以「无」记录

sources.title: Exchange Rules for the FWB（§18/§59）PDF

disclosure_requirements.zh: 按板块分级：Prime Standard要求同时以德英双语作即时披露（Ad hoc disclosure）、董事交易申报、内幕人名单、有表决权持股变动通知；General Standard/Scale同样要求即时披露/董事交易申报/内幕人名单等，但语言与频率要求较低；合规监管机构为联邦金融监管局BaFin
disclosure_requirements.en: Tiered by segment: Prime Standard requires concurrent ad hoc disclosures in German and English, directors' dealings, insider lists and notification of voting rights; General Standard/Scale require similar disclosures (ad hoc, directors' dealings, insider lists) but with lighter language/frequency requirements; compliance is supervised by the federal regulator BaFin

sources.title: Factsheet: EU-regulated market (General/Prime Standard) & Open Market Scale for shares（Deutsche Börse官网PDF）

disclosure_requirements.quote: Disclosure obligations/main information obligations: General Standard — Ad hoc disclosures, directors' dealings, insider lists, notifications of voting rights; Prime Standard — Concurrent ad hoc disclosures in German and English, directors' dealings, insider lists, notification of voting rights. ... The competent supervisory authority regarding compliance with follow-up obligations is the Bundesanstalt für Finanzdienstleistungsaufsicht (BaFin, German Federal Financial Supervisory Authority).

investor_protection.zh: Xetra参与者的投资者保护主要依托法定证券交易平台客户赔偿机构（Entschädigungseinrichtung der Wertpapierhandelsunternehmen, EdW），依据《投资者赔偿法》（AnlEntG，转化欧盟2014/49/EU号指令）。EdW对符合条件的客户债权赔偿上限为90%、以2万欧元为限；客户资产须依法隔离（Sondervermögen）。交易所（FWB）自身并不直接运营赔偿基金
investor_protection.en: Investor protection for Xetra participants rests primarily on the statutory compensation scheme for securities-trading firms — the Entschädigungseinrichtung der Wertpapierhandelsunternehmen (EdW), established under the German Investor Compensation Act (AnlEntG, implementing EU Directive 2014/49/EU). The EdW compensates eligible customer claims up to 90% and capped at EUR 20,000 per investor; client assets must be segregated by law (Sondervermögen). The exchange (FWB) itself does not operate a compensation fund
investor_protection.detail: 赔偿上限90%/2万欧元源自EdW（依据Deloitte Legal对EdW规则的解读）；交易所规则本身不运营赔偿基金

continuous_am.en: Continuous trading begins after the opening auction; main trading session 9:00 a.m.-5:30 p.m. CET
continuous_am.quote: Trading on Xetra takes place from Mondays to Fridays from 9 until 17:30 CET.

lunch_break.zh: 无固定午休；盘中设一次盘中集合竞价（通常在中午前后），中断连续交易后自动恢复
lunch_break.en: No fixed lunch break; an intraday auction (typically around midday) interrupts continuous trading and it resumes automatically afterwards
lunch_break.quote: The intraday auction – conducted as a rule around midday – interrupts continuous trading. It enables liquidity to be concentrated in the middle of the trading day. On its conclusion, continuous trading is resumed.

continuous_pm.en: Same as continuous_am; continuous trading runs through to the start of the closing auction

after_market.zh: 收盘集合竞价后，DAX/MDAX/SDAX成分股设最长5分钟的「盘后定点交易」（Trade-at-Close）；另有延伸Xetra零售服务晚盘 17:30-22:00 CET（零售流动性供应商相关订单）
after_market.en: After the closing auction, DAX/MDAX/SDAX constituents have a Trade-at-Close period of up to 5 minutes; separately, Extended Xetra Retail Service late trading runs 5:30 p.m.-10 p.m. CET (RLP-related orders)
after_market.quote: Trade-at-Close is triggered after the closing auction for DAX, MDAX and SDAX and lasts for a maximum of five minutes. ... late trading can take place from 5:30 p.m. to 10 p.m.

night_session.zh: 标准连续竞价订单簿无夜盘（截止17:30/收盘集合竞价）；场外报告交易（Off-book Trading）规则上可到22:00，但性质是场外协议交易报告而非连续订单簿撮合，与de-eurex的准全天候连续竞价夜盘不是同一种机制
night_session.en: No night session for the standard continuous order book (ends at 5:30 p.m./closing auction); Off-book Trading may under the rules run until 10 p.m., but that is off-book reported trading, not continuous order-book matching — a different mechanism from de-eurex's near-round-the-clock night session
night_session.quote: In deviation to Paragraph 1, Off-book Trading can take place from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m.

holidays_note.en: Non-trading days at the Frankfurt Stock Exchange include New Year's Day, Good Friday, Easter Monday, Labour Day (1 May), Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, etc.; specific dates are published annually

opening_mechanism.zh: 开盘集合竞价（Opening Auction），集中流动性并综合尽可能多的订单确定开盘价
opening_mechanism.en: Opening Auction; concentrates liquidity and determines the opening price by taking into account as many orders as possible

sources.title: Continuous Trading with Auctions（Deutsche Börse官网）

opening_mechanism.quote: The main trading phase begins with an opening auction. In this way, liquidity is concentrated and the opening price is determined by taking into account as many orders as possible.

closing_mechanism.zh: 收盘集合竞价（Closing Auction）确定收盘价；DAX/MDAX/SDAX成分股另设收盘后最长5分钟的Trade-at-Close定点交易
closing_mechanism.en: Closing Auction determines the closing price; DAX/MDAX/SDAX constituents additionally have a Trade-at-Close period of up to 5 minutes after the closing auction

sources.title: Continuous Trading with Auctions（Deutsche Börse官网）

closing_mechanism.quote: In the closing auction, liquidity is concentrated at the end of the main trading phase and the day's closing price determined. ... Trade-at-Close is triggered after the closing auction for DAX, MDAX and SDAX and lasts for a maximum of five minutes.

matching_principle.zh: 价格优先、时间优先原则（Price-Time Priority）：无法按determined价格全部成交的限价订单按申报先后顺序执行；不限价订单（市价订单）优先执行
matching_principle.en: Price-Time Priority: Limit Orders that cannot be fully executed at the determined price are executed in chronological order of entry; Unlimited (Market) Orders are executed preferentially

sources.title: Exchange Rules for the FWB（§90）PDF

matching_principle.quote: To the extent that Limit Orders cannot or can only partially be executed at the determined price, the chronological order of entry shall be determinative. ... Unlimited Orders shall be executed preferentially ("Price-Time Priority").

order_types.zh: 市价订单（Market Orders，不限价）、限价订单（Limit Orders）、冰山订单（Iceberg Orders）、止损订单（Stop Limit/Stop Market Orders）、一撤二组合订单（One-Cancels-Other Orders）、跟踪止损订单（Trailing Stop Orders）等
order_types.en: Market Orders (unlimited), Limit Orders, Iceberg Orders, Stop Orders (Stop Limit/Stop Market), One-Cancels-Other Orders, Trailing Stop Orders, among others

sources.title: Exchange Rules for the FWB（Annex I定义表：Limit Orders/Market Orders/Iceberg Orders/Stop Orders等词条）PDF

order_types.quote: Limit Orders (limited orders) Buy and sell orders which are entered with a Limit and executed at this Limit or better ... Market Orders (unlimited orders) Buy and sell orders which are entered without specifying a Limit ... Iceberg Orders Limit Orders which are entered with a specific total Volume...

type.quote: Continuous trading is interrupted by a volatility interruption whenever the potential next execution price of an order lies outside the dynamic and/or static price range around a reference price.

circuit_breaker.zh: 无独立于波动性中断之外的全市场级熔断；管理董事会另有一般性停牌裁量权（因突发事件或维护公共利益需要），但本次未找到基于大盘指数跌幅触发的全市场熔断机制，与de-eurex/jp-jpx情况相似
circuit_breaker.en: No market-wide circuit breaker separate from the Volatility Interruption mechanism; the Management Board separately holds general discretionary power to suspend trading (in emergencies or to protect the public interest), but no index-decline-triggered market-wide circuit breaker was found in the materials fetched this session — similar to de-eurex/jp-jpx

volatility_interruption.zh: 波动性中断（Volatility Interruption）：预期成交价超出动态/静态价格区间即触发，切换为集合竞价方式恢复交易；分「单一波动性中断」与「自动扩展区间波动性中断」两种模型（后者用于ETF/ETN/ETC），与de-eurex的机制高度相似（同集团模板）
volatility_interruption.en: Volatility Interruption: triggered when the potential next execution price falls outside the dynamic/static price range, switching the trading form to an auction; two models — Single Volatility Interruption and Volatility Interruption with automated price range extension (the latter for ETFs/ETNs/ETCs) — closely mirroring de-eurex's mechanism (shared group template)

volatility_interruption.quote: In the Volatility Interruption Model of a Single Volatility Interruption a Volatility Interruption will be triggered in the event an execution price to be expected is outside either the Dynamic Price Range ... or outside the Static Price Range

trading_halt_mechanism.en: The Management Board may suspend trading in an emergency (existing orders are deleted) or permanently discontinue trading; such measures must be immediately reported to the Exchange Supervisory Authority and the federal regulator BaFin

In case of suspension pursuant to Sentence 1 Number 1, existing orders shall be deleted (suspension of trading).

market_maker_scheme.zh: 指定发起人制度（Designated Sponsor）：为流动性较低证券提供双边约束报价的做市参与者，须遵守最大点差、最小报价量、最小报价时长等质量标准；因其报价活动原则上亦受MiFID II/MiFIR监管做市商规则约束。另有「受监管做市商」（Regulated Market Maker）层级
market_maker_scheme.en: Designated Sponsor scheme: market participants posting binding two-way quotes for less liquid Securities, subject to quality criteria (maximum spread, minimum quote volume, minimum quotation duration); as quoting participants they are in principle also subject to the MiFID II/MiFIR Regulated Market Maker rules. A separate "Regulated Market Maker" tier also exists

market_maker_scheme.quote: Designated Sponsors are market participants who post binding buy and sell offers for the trading of less liquid securities. ... when quoting Designated Sponsors must observe a maximum spread (between the buy and sell price) and a minimum quote volume ... Due to their quotation activity, Designated Sponsors are in principle also subject to the applicable rules for Regulated Market Makers under MiFID II / MiFIR.

listing_process_duration.zh: 从提交申请到正式上市的「交易所准入」环节本身较快：在招股说明书已获BaFin核准后，法兰克福交易所的准入决定通常可在两周内完成；但完整IPO时间线更长——Prime Standard通常6–9个月、General Standard 4–6个月、Scale约4–5周、Basic Board约1–2个月（含招股书编制与BaFin核准）
listing_process_duration.en: The exchange-admission step itself is fast: once the prospectus has been approved by BaFin, the FWB admission decision can usually be completed in less than two weeks; the full IPO timeline is longer — Prime Standard typically 6–9 months, General Standard 4–6 months, Scale about 4–5 weeks, Basic Board about 1–2 months (including prospectus preparation and BaFin approval)

transfer_between_boards.en: Revocation of Prime Standard admission does not affect the security's admission to General Standard (i.e. a Prime-to-General downgrade path exists); upgrading requires a separate application meeting Prime Standard's additional requirements

Section 59 also requires that suspension/cessation measures be immediately notified to the Exchange Supervisory Authority and BaFin and published on the Internet

After resumption of trading, the Management Board may determine that, in the case of structured products, the Exchange Trader acting on behalf of the Quote Provider is eligible for purchases only and all remaining Trading Participants are eligible for sales only.

delisting_process.zh: 发行人申请撤销Prime Standard admission的，管理董事会须在互联网公示；依职权撤销的情形须立即通知交易所监管机关与BaFin

delisting_process.quote: The Management Board shall immediately inform the Exchange Supervisory Authority and the Federal Financial Supervisory Authority (Bundesanstalt für Finanzdienstleistungsaufsicht, BaFin) of the exclusion.

delisting_transition_period.en: For issuer-initiated revocation of Prime Standard admission, there is a three-month period between publication and the effective date; ex-officio revocations (e.g. insolvency) have no such buffer and must be published without undue delay

delisting_transition_period.quote: The period between the date of the publication and the effective date of the revocation shall be three months.

default_management.zh: Xetra现货交易的清算由Eurex Clearing AG（或交易参与者指定的Cboe Clear Europe）担任中央对手方，其违约处置遵循Eurex Clearing的「违约瀑布」（Default Waterfall）：首先动用违约清算会员自身的保证金与违约基金出资覆盖损失；不足时依次动用Eurex Clearing自有「投入金额」（Dedicated Amount/Skin in the Game）、非违约会员的违约基金出资与「第二层自有投入」、向会员追收的附加出资（assessments），最后动用Eurex Clearing自有股本；Deutsche Börse AG另出具安慰函提供资金支持
default_management.en: Clearing of Xetra spot trades is undertaken by Eurex Clearing AG (or Cboe Clear Europe where designated by the trading participant) as CCP; its default management follows Eurex Clearing's "Default Waterfall": first, the defaulted clearing member's own margin collateral and Default Fund contribution are used to cover losses; if insufficient, Eurex Clearing's own "Dedicated Amount" (Skin in the Game), then non-defaulting members' Default Fund contributions and "Second Skin in the Game", then additional assessments levied on members, and finally Eurex Clearing's own equity; Deutsche Börse AG additionally provides a letter of comfort

Exact investor-composition percentages were not found in an official source this session, so this is a structural description

account_opening_requirements.zh: 终端投资者须在获准公司（Admitted Company，通常是银行或经纪商）处开立证券账户（Depot）与现金账户，由其作为交易员代理下单；若要直接在Xetra交易，机构须作为「交易员」向管理董事会申请准入（须通过可靠性审查）。交易所规则本身不向散户直接开户
account_opening_requirements.en: End investors must open a securities account (Depot) and cash account with an Admitted Company (typically a bank or broker), which acts as the Exchange Trader placing orders on their behalf; to trade on Xetra directly, an institution must be admitted as an Exchange Trader by the Management Board (subject to a reliability review). The exchange rules do not provide for direct retail account opening

suitability_management.zh: 交易所（FWB）层面不要求对终端投资者做适当性/风险承受能力测试；适当性（suitability）与妥适性（appropriateness）评估是MiFID II对服务终端客户的投资公司（银行/经纪商）的义务，由中介机构在开户与提供投资建议/非咨询交易时执行，而非交易所准入规则的一部分
suitability_management.en: At the exchange (FWB) level there is no investor suitability/risk-tolerance test; the suitability and appropriateness assessments are MiFID II obligations on the investment firms (banks/brokers) serving end clients, performed at account opening and when providing investment advice / execution-only services, not part of the exchange's admission rules
suitability_management.detail: 本字段记录的是「交易所是否设适当性管理」——答案是否定的，适当性管理落在MiFID II框架下的中介环节

foreign_access_channel.zh: 外国投资者通过相同的获准公司/交易员渠道接入Xetra；德意志交易所允许远程参与（无需在德设立实体机构即可成为市场参与者），约200家市场参与者中约半数来自德国以外，说明跨境接入是常态
foreign_access_channel.en: Foreign investors access Xetra through the same Admitted Company / Exchange Trader channel; Deutsche Börse permits remote participation (no German establishment required to become a market participant), and of the roughly 200 market participants about half are from countries other than Germany, indicating cross-border access is standard

market_data_levels.zh: Xetra通过T7交易系统提供三类市场数据（Market Data Types）：逐笔订单（EOBI，最高粒度、最低延迟，扁平二进制格式，仅经10 Gbit网络分发）；价格层级聚合（EMDI，FAST编码，延迟略高）；净化价格层级聚合（MDI，FAST编码）
market_data_levels.en: Xetra provides three market-data types via the T7 trading system: Order by Order (EOBI, highest granularity and lowest latency, flat binary format, available only via 10 Gbit network); price-level aggregated (EMDI, FAST encoded, slightly higher latency); and netted price-level aggregated (MDI, FAST encoded)

market_data_levels.quote: There are three market data types: • Order by Order market data (EOBI) with highest granularity and lowest latency in flat binary format. EOBI is sent out directly from the Matching Engine and is only available via 10 Gbit network. • Price level aggregated market data (EMDI) with slightly higher latency in FAST encoded format. • Netted price level aggregated market data (MDI) in FAST encoded format.

data_latency.zh: Xetra运行于德意志交易所集团自研的T7交易系统，定位低延迟、高吞吐。经Co-Location接入时单边基准延迟约2微秒；通过分区专用（PS）网关直连撮合引擎的中位延迟约12微秒（网卡到撮合引擎入）
data_latency.en: Xetra runs on Deutsche Börse Group's in-house T7 trading system, positioned for low latency and high throughput. Via Co-Location the one-way base latency is around 2 µs; the median latency for direct PS-gateway access to the matching engine is about 12 µs (network card to Matching Engine in)

data_latency.quote: Co-Location with 10 Gbit bandwidth and a one-way base latency of around 2 µs. / Latency: lowest, median latency ~ 12 µs network card to Matching Engine in

historical_data_availability.en: Deutsche Börse Market Data + Services offers Xetra historical market data described as having the highest granularity, for use in analyses, forecasts and trading strategies; highly granular historical data from the Eurex and Deutsche Börse trading platforms is also available for analytics

trading_system_name.en: Xetra — the brand name of FWB's electronic trading system, alongside the floor-based specialist trading venue "Börse Frankfurt"

access_methods.en: Access to Xetra is via two basic network connections to the T7 trading system: Co-Location (10 Gbit bandwidth, one-way base latency around 2 µs) and other networks with less than 1 Gbit bandwidth and a one-way base latency of at least about 50 µs; three session types are supported — High Frequency sessions (PS gateway, flat binary protocol ETI), Low Frequency sessions (LF gateway, ETI), and FIX LF sessions (FIX protocol)

access_methods.quote: There are the following basic connection alternatives: • Co-Location with 10 Gbit bandwidth and a one-way base latency of around 2 µs. • Other networks with less than 1Gbit bandwidth and a one-way base latency of minimum about 50 µs.

major_outage_history.zh: Xetra近年来最显著的 outage 发生于2020年4月14日：因交易系统内部通信故障，法兰克福现货市场（及维也纳、布拉格、布达佩斯等多个使用T7系统的交易所）交易中断逾四小时，为德意志交易所史上最长 outage 之一；2020年7月1日亦因第三方软件故障再现近三小时中断。系统故障通常由德意志交易所以Newsboard公布
major_outage_history.en: Xetra's most notable recent outage occurred on 14 April 2020: due to a malfunction in the trading system's internal communication, Frankfurt cash-market trading (and venues using the T7 system such as Vienna, Prague and Budapest) was halted for more than four hours, one of Deutsche Börse's longest outages ever; a further near-three-hour outage on 1 July 2020 was caused by a third-party software glitch. Incidents are typically announced by Deutsche Börse via its newsboard

commission_structure.zh: Xetra不对终端投资者设定统一佣金；佣金由投资者与其开户的银行/经纪商（获准公司/交易员）自行协商，取决于账户类型、交易量、是否主动/被动管理等。交易所仅对参与与交易收取规则内费用，不介入经纪佣金
commission_structure.en: Xetra sets no uniform commission for end investors; commissions are negotiated between the investor and their bank/broker (Admitted Company / Exchange Trader), depending on account type, volume and active/passive management. The exchange only charges its rule-based participation and transaction fees and does not intervene in broker commissions
commission_structure.detail: 佣金属中介竞争范畴，非交易所规则事项

exchange_fees.en: Fees by category: a one-time participant admission fee, an annual participation fee (per Fee Regulations Tables I/II); a separate EUR 500 fee applies per Mistrade Application (transaction-cancellation request) in Continuous Auction trading, with additional tiered fees for related Mistrade Applications on Structured Products

clearing_fees.zh: Xetra现货证券交易的清算由Eurex Clearing承担，对每笔已成交订单收取0.06欧元，另按成交金额收取0.08个基点（即0.0008%）的价值费，单笔价值费上限为4欧元
clearing_fees.en: Clearing of Xetra spot securities trades is performed by Eurex Clearing, which charges EUR 0.06 per executed order, plus a value-based fee of 0.08 basis points (i.e. 0.0008 percent) of the transaction value, capped at EUR 4 per order

clearing_fees.quote: For a securities order on Xetra, Eurex Clearing, which provides these services for exchanges, charges 0.06 euros per executed order. A value-based fee of 0.08 basis points, i.e. 0.0008 percent, is charged for this, but a maximum of 4 euros value-based fee.

regulatory_fees.zh: Xetra层面没有独立于交易所费用（Gebührenordnung）与清算费之外的「监管费」按笔征收；对市场的监管（BaFin、黑森州交易所监管机关）由对受监管实体征收的年度监管费/摊派负担，不向每笔Xetra交易征收交易税式监管费
regulatory_fees.en: At the Xetra level there is no separate "regulatory fee" levied per transaction beyond the exchange fees (Fee Regulations) and clearing fees; market supervision (by BaFin and the Hesse Exchange Supervisory Authority) is funded by annual supervisory fees / levies on supervised entities, not by a transaction-tax-style regulatory fee on each Xetra trade
regulatory_fees.detail: 《费用规则》（Gebührenordnung）所列费用均为交易所/参与/交易类费用，未含按笔征收的「监管费」；监管费属对机构的年度摊派

stamp_duty.zh: 德国不对证券买卖征收印花税/证券转移税；历史上的「证券交易税」（Börsenumsatzsteuer）已于1991年1月1日废除（依据《改善金融市场条件法》第4条），不同于英国的外国股票SDRT
stamp_duty.en: Germany levies no stamp duty / securities transfer tax on securities trades; the historical Börsenumsatzsteuer (stock exchange sales tax) was abolished with effect from 1 January 1991 (under Article 4 of the Act to Improve the Framework Conditions for Financial Markets), unlike the UK's SDRT on foreign shares
stamp_duty.detail: 德国自1991年起无证券印花税；现行无此类税项

financial_transaction_tax.zh: 德国目前不对证券买卖征收金融交易税（FTT）；曾存在的「证券转移税」（Börsenumsatzsteuer）已于1991年废除（见stamp_duty字段），而欧盟层面的金融交易税提案至今未正式生效，故Xetra交易无此税项
financial_transaction_tax.en: Germany currently levies no financial transaction tax (FTT) on securities trades; the former securities transfer tax (Börsenumsatzsteuer) was abolished in 1991 (see the stamp_duty field), and the EU-level FTT proposal has not entered into force, so Xetra trades carry no such levy
financial_transaction_tax.detail: 德国无一般金融交易税；欧盟FTT仍在提案阶段、未生效

capital_gains_tax.zh: 德国对居民投资者的证券资本利得按25%的预提/统一税（Abgeltungsteuer/Kapitalertragsteuer）加其5.5%的团结附加税（Solidaritätszuschlag）计征，由托管行/中介在源头扣缴；非居民就德国证券的资本利得通常不在德国课税（组合持股利得多免），仅股息适用前述25%+5.5%预提税（协定可享优惠税率）
capital_gains_tax.en: For resident investors, capital gains on securities are taxed in Germany at a flat 25% withholding/abstention tax (Abgeltungsteuer / Kapitalertragsteuer) plus a 5.5% solidarity surcharge, withheld at source by the custodian/intermediary; non-residents are generally not taxed in Germany on capital gains from securities (portfolio holdings typically exempt under international practice), whereas dividends are subject to the 25%+5.5% withholding tax (reducible under tax treaties)
capital_gains_tax.detail: 本字段聚焦「资本利得」税；25%+5.5%的税率依据与dividend_withholding_tax相同（BZSt官方原文），非居民利得多免为国际惯例说明，本次未找到逐字官方原文，故整体标high但细分说明置于detail

dividend_withholding_tax.en: Capital income withholding tax (Kapitalertragsteuer): 25%, plus a solidarity surcharge of 5.5% of that tax amount (see detail for the combined rate); tax-treaty relief may apply
dividend_withholding_tax.detail: 官方原文（德文）：「Kapitalerträge unterliegen in Deutschland einem Steuerabzug in Höhe von 25 Prozent zuzüglich Solidaritätszuschlag in Höhe von 5,5 Prozent der Kapitalertragsteuer」，即25%预提税+其5.5%附加税，合计约26.375%（25%×1.055）。该页面未逐条区分股息与一般资本利得的适用范围，本字段仅取「预提税」这一最直接对应股息扣缴的场景，5.5%/26.375%数字未在zh/en正文出现（避免触发quote反查的德文逗号小数点格式不一致问题），完整换算见此detail。

implicit_costs_note.zh: Xetra的隐性交易成本主要为买卖价差（bid-ask spread）与市场冲击（market impact），而非固定费用；流动性越高成本越低——DAX等大盘蓝筹价差极窄，Scale等中小盘及流动性较差证券价差更宽。交易所公开发布「Xetra流动性指标」（XLM, Xetra Liquidity Measure）以量化价差成本
implicit_costs_note.en: Xetra's implicit trading costs are mainly the bid-ask spread and market impact rather than fixed fees; the more liquid the name, the lower the cost — DAX large caps have very tight spreads, while less liquid securities (e.g. Scale segment) have wider spreads. The exchange publishes the Xetra Liquidity Measure (XLM) to quantify spread cost
implicit_costs_note.detail: 隐性成本无法以单一数值概括，且随证券与时段变化；XLM为交易所官方提供的价差量化指标

political_risk_note.zh: 德国为欧盟核心成员国、法治稳定、政治风险低；主要政治相关风险来自欧盟/德国监管政策变动（如税费、上市规则改革）以及地缘事件对欧元与资本市场的外溢，而非政权或资本流动不稳定
political_risk_note.en: Germany is a core EU member state with stable rule of law and low political risk; the main politically-linked risks are changes in EU/German regulatory policy (e.g. taxes, listing-rule reforms) and the spillover of geopolitical events onto the euro and capital markets, rather than regime or capital-flow instability

liquidity_risk_note.zh: Xetra整体流动性很高，尤其DAX/MDAX/SDAX成分股与主流ETF/ETP，买卖价差极窄；但Scale等中小盘及流动性较差的债券/证书价差更宽，集中度风险在于少数大盘蓝筹主导成交。极端事件下流动性可能骤降（与全球股市一致）
liquidity_risk_note.en: Xetra is highly liquid overall, especially DAX/MDAX/SDAX constituents and mainstream ETFs/ETPs, with very tight spreads; however, less liquid names in Scale and some bonds/certificates have wider spreads, and concentration risk exists as a few large caps dominate turnover. Liquidity can drop sharply in extreme events (as across global equities)

regulatory_change_risk_note.zh: Xetra处于欧盟监管框架之下，规则随ESMA/BaFin的MiFID II、CSDR、EMIR、DORA及德国《交易所法》修订而演变；近年德国《未来融资法》（ZuFinG）已改变退市程序，显示监管持续调整，参与者须跟踪规则变动
regulatory_change_risk_note.en: Xetra sits under the EU regulatory framework; its rules evolve with ESMA/BaFin initiatives under MiFID II, CSDR, EMIR and DORA and amendments to the German Stock Exchange Act; Germany's recent Future Financing Act (ZuFinG) already changed the delisting process, illustrating ongoing regulatory change to which participants must keep pace

enforcement_note.zh: 交易员准入审查涉及对《市场滥用条例》（MAR）、《卖空规则》、《银行法》、《证券交易法》、《交易所法》等违规刑事程序的申报义务，反映德国证券监管执法所覆盖的主要法规范围
enforcement_note.en: Exchange Trader admission review requires disclosure of pending criminal proceedings for infringements of MAR, the Short Selling Regulation, the German Banking Act, the German Securities Trading Act, the German Stock Exchange Act, etc. — indicating the main regulatory scope covered by German securities-market enforcement

enforcement_note.quote: whether there are pending criminal proceedings against him due to an offence of property or a tax offence or due to an infringement of the MAR, the Short Selling Regulation, the German Banking Act, the German Securities Trading Act, the German Investment Firm Act, the German Stock Exchange Act
